entries.message: Crest fills names, emails, phone numbers and addresses from the identities you keep in each Space, with a native anchored suggestion list on WebKit and Chromium pages that never auto-submits a form and never touches password, payment or one-time code fields.

Bring your addresses and contacts from Arc: Data Portability reads Arc's autofill database read-only, lists every profile it finds, lets you choose exactly which records to move, and imports them into the Space you pick.
